summary: Busy school and shops car park with homes all round; east edge least overlooked.
reasons: Homes within 25 m on most sides
Full of daytime cars, likely school or shops
Sealed with room to pull in

drivers.seclusion: Nearest mapped dwellings are 3 m at 93 m and 15 m at 28 m; school halls 30 m away; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park open to the street, full of marked bays; room to park fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Edmondstone Street arterial beside it, school zone and crossing nearby.
drivers.convention: Dense with cars by day, so a van blends in; overnight use unknown and likely signed.

flags: Steep along the east edge: about 6.7% grade

No Stopping sign on adjacent kerb
sun_shade: Open asphalt, full sun; tall trees shade only the south-west corner.

best_section.where: East edge of the car park, beside Edmondstone Street, south of the entrance
